question: Will a read-only, contradiction-triggered sharpening of the existing NativeEpisodeExperience posterior over retained old causal blocks improve recovery after unannounced structural shifts, without erasing old memories or relying on hidden rule labels?
mechanism: Branch-only opt-in NativeEpisodeExperience.context_forecast_recall: when an endogenous stream contradiction detector has fired within the last 24 genuine episodes, square the posterior context-model weights and normalize before reading native transition and terminal forecasts; otherwise call unchanged context_forecast. Learn and retain evidence ONLY through original native.observe/stream. No new controller/learner, no inferred outcomes, no oracle boundary, no accepted change.
worlds: Two independent worlds per seed; each unannounced stochastic A->novel B->A return at private variable boundaries with random paired-view nuisance bits and authentic two-stage action/transition/reward consequences. Two source family variants: family0 previously described XOR-vs-OR transition/terminal structures; family1 a conjunction-gated transition and independent parity-vs-disjunction terminal structural change (not relabeling). The variant is generated evaluator-only and NOT passed to the native or conventional predictors.
source_and_split: Actual source-only episodes from independent simulator seed and world; sequential actions sampled independent of regime/outcome, same for all arms. First 48 witnessed events warm old native memory, begin native stream ONCE before rule changes. A first period 96+/-8; B 72+/-8; return A 64. Score transition before next-state observation, terminal after next-state is observed but before reward. Regime and phase labels used only to score afterwards.
controls: Same native stream with local repair=False as native ablation
Fully fitted independent Beta(1,1) causal transition+terminal cell full history
Fully trained sliding-window12, sliding-window24 and sliding-window48 conventional Beta(1,1)
Fully updated exponential-discount0.85 and discount0.95 conventional Beta
Online prequential conventional Hedge mixture over all 6 conventional models, fixed eta=4 (updated only after real observed outcome)
metrics: Prequential transition+conditional-terminal mean squared/Brier loss per episode, grouped by stable A, first24 B, late B, first24 A-return, late A-return and pooled late B+late return. Identical observations/actions/model capacity accounting and per-episode forecast receipts for all native and conventional arms. Native detector counts, context source archive SHA, model/checkpoint byte identity, actual observed event IDs, duplicate/contradiction atomicity, CPU/wall per seed.
frozen_go: Both original pilots: candidate recall Brier on pooled late B+late return <=0.145 AND >=0.025 absolute lower than BOTH unmodified native stream AND strongest of ALL independently fully fitted conventional controls (including online Hedge) on same seed, and <= unmodified native stream during early B and late A-return; native prestream predictions exactly equal original; cold byte identity, all genuine source IDs, first48 prefix and old complete context-block SHA preserved, context readout causes zero checkpoint mutation, conflicting duplicate rejected, negative controls/auditor PASS. Else SCREEN_NO_GO. Pilot GO never SCIENTIFIC_PASS; require independently qualified held primary and unfamiliar transfer first.
source_custody: Preregister BEFORE feature/source changes; DEV-only smoke tests disjoint seeds; freeze Git blobs of native method, campaign, tests, independent auditor, workflow before one-shot pilots. Independent audit reconstructs public truth and strong conventional predictors without importing campaign/native learner, score original Git-sealed receipts. Exact final two-OS full regression at post-seal SHA. Never rerun or tune original pilots.
science_boundary: This is engineering-only synthetic observed-action training of one existing native learner; read-only posterior sharpening is not an independent intelligence system or proof of GI. No accepted model/runtimes, no Forge/controller integration, no scheduled tasks, no merge/promotion/live operation.
